correctness.rationale: PASS: Reconstructed sigma_m^h(0): for h<m, length 2^h and a unique terminal h, then Q_j=sigma_m^(m-1)(j) is concatenation of lower-index sigma_m^h(0) avoiding letter m-1 with length 2^(m-1)-2^(j-1). Expanding sigma_m^m(x) exactly gives x=P B_{x0}B_{x1}..., each block has all m letters only upon its unique terminal m-1 and so is a shortest greedy arch. The standard arch-subsequence theorem gives U_m(N)=the rare-letter prefix count at every N, not only special substitution boundaries. Letter preimage equations give U_m(L_n)=L_(n-m), while primitive incidence matrix equations lambda f0=1,lambda f_j=f_(j-1) give f_(m-1)=lambda^-m and arch frequencies lambda^-(j+1). Independent regeneration of substitution words for m=2..7 over 30,000-symbol prefixes matched arch endpoints to rare-letter positions and verified first 2000 coded gaps; finite tests only corroborate the all-m morphism argument.

value.rationale: PASS: The multinacci word is a canonical family of recurrent morphic words, and exact scattered-subsequence universality of EVERY finite prefix is a natural complexity statistic. The self-similar decomposition does more than list gap lengths: it codes the entire infinite fixed point, recovers exact morphic-prefix counts, and yields a density. This is a motivated structural theorem rather than a recomputed finite table.

final_claim: For every multinacci substitution sigma_m and integer m>=2, its fixed point admits the exact infinite greedy arch factorization x=P B_{x0}B_{x1}..., with P=sigma_m^(m-1)(0), each B_j of length 2^m-2^j ending in the sole occurrence of letter m-1; every prefix universality index equals its number of letter m-1 occurrences, U_m(L_n)=L_(n-m) for n>=m, and limiting density lambda_m^(-m).
limitations: Arbitrary m asymptotic density follows Perron–Frobenius primitivity, not finite enumeration.
No claim of novelty for classical return-word existence and derived-word generalities.
